title: Brand Support Studies
description: Five independent studies that extend the gym brand to class, recovery, storefront, and welcome-package surfaces.
creative_direction: Independent rollout studies for Gym Brand Poster and Membership System. These images test how a fictional gym brand can scale across internal and external marketing surfaces while staying clean, text-free, and commercially credible.
